SUPPLEMENT — bounded offline unlock probe complete. The probe came back empty on every axis, so per your instruction I declare the blocker FINAL: the headline integer (DGEs in the KEGG glutathione metabolism set) remains undetermined, and I have not invented a gene set. DE results are unchanged: 1,438 significant DGEs (850 up / 588 down in KD) under the literal p<0.05 reading.

You were right about the evidence gap, and it is now closed properly:

(a) Cross-filesystem sweep WITHOUT -xdev. Mounts printed first for audit (results/unlock_probe.txt): root is tmpfs `/`; `/usr`, `/bin`, `/lib`, `/lib64`, `/etc/ld.so.cache` are /dev/nvme1n1p2 (ext4, ro); the persona venv, the uv-python files and `/workspace` are NFS (<NFS_SERVER>:<NFS_VOLUME>/...). No /opt, /data, /srv, no conda envs, no reference volume exists in this namespace. Sweeping all of them for *.gmt, *.gmt.gz, *kegg*, *enrichr*, *geneset*, *gene_set*, *hallmark*, *ortholog*, *ensg2*, *ensm*, gseapy*, pydeseq2*, mygene*, decoupler*, *.whl returned 14 hits, of which ZERO are gene-set/gseapy-like: pip-25.0.1 / setuptools-78.1.1 / pip-25.1.1 wheels, dateutil-zoneinfo.tar.gz, guestfs supermin tarballs, usb_modeswitch/qemu tarballs, and groff's symbol.map. No wheelhouse; pip cache empty ("No locally built wheels cached", /tmp/cache/pip); no conda pkgs; nothing relevant in /var/cache.

(b) Interpreters/package roots: 10 interpreter paths enumerated — /bin/python3, /bin/python3.14, /usr/bin/python3, /usr/bin/python3.14 (system 3.14.4; root /usr/lib/python3/dist-packages, 250 entries), the persona venv .actor-venv/bin/python{,3,3.12} (3.12.14; 24 entries: numpy/pandas/scipy/statsmodels/openpyxl/patsy/pip only), and uv cpython-3.12.14 bin/python{,3,3.12} (its site-packages is an EMPTY tmpfs overlay). Import matrix: gseapy "no", mygene "no", pydeseq2 "no", decoupler "no", Bio "no" in all ten. One correction in the runner's favour: `requests` IS importable in the four system python3.14 entries — my first report missed it by probing only the venv. It is useless here: requests.get on Enrichr dies with `OSError: Could not find a suitable TLS CA certificate bundle, invalid path: /etc/ssl/certs/ca-certificates.crt` (file absent), and there is no interface to send on (see c). No site-package bundles a GMT/KEGG/geneset file, and `grep -rl ENSMUSG /usr/lib/python3/dist-packages /usr/share` returns nothing — with a positive control proving traversal works: `grep -rl glutathione /usr/share` -> /usr/share/hunspell/en_US.dic, 97,430 files seen under /usr/share. R is nowhere: `find / -name Rscript` over all mounts -> none; `dpkg -l | grep -icE 'r-base|bioconductor'` -> 0; no /usr/lib/R, /usr/local/lib/R or /opt/R.

(c) Proxy/mirror closure: no http_proxy/https_proxy/no_proxy/PIP_INDEX_URL/PIP_* env vars; `pip config list` empty; /etc/pip.conf plus per-user pip.conf absent; /etc/hosts, /etc/resolv.conf and /etc/nsswitch.conf do not exist in the sandbox; no /run or /var/run proxy socket. Decisive: /proc/net/dev lists interfaces ['lo'] only and /proc/net/route has 0 non-header route lines — the namespace was built with `--unshare-net`, so there is no egress path at all, with or without a proxy.

(d) Capsule re-inspection: the capsule provides exactly ONE data file. `find /workspace` (excluding my outputs) = data/count.csv + task.json (+ my analysis/ and results/); task.json input_assets = [{'asset_id': 'count.csv'}] and documents = {'benchmark_canary': '<canary GUID string>'} — no gene sets, no symbol map, no annotation manifest; count.csv header is still just geneID,KL1,KL2,KL3,WL1,WL2,WL3.

Consistency items, both settled:
1. EXECUTED number is 11,634 (baseMean = rowMeans of MEDIAN-OF-RATIOS-normalised counts, the DESeq2 definition the engine uses). My plan-time 11,645 came from a quick pre-run check that scaled by TOTAL COUNTS (counts/library x mean-library-size). The normalisations differ most for KL3 (size factor 0.8222 vs library ratio 0.9626), and exactly 19 genes flip their baseMean>10 status — all at executed baseMean 9.71-10.10, i.e. right on the threshold. 11,634 is the number in every reported table.
2. Confirmed: 4,720 (p<0.05) and 3,377 (padj<0.05) are BEFORE the |lfc|>1 and baseMean>10 filters, over the 15,900 testable genes (5,984 all-zero rows are left untested, p/padj = NA). Full cascade from the executed table: 21,884 rows -> tested 15,900 -> p<0.05 alone 4,720 | padj<0.05 alone 3,377 | baseMean>10 alone 11,634 -> p<0.05 AND baseMean>10 = 4,487 -> AND |shrunken log2FC|>1 = 1,438 (primary).
3. Confirmed: results/deg_significant_primary.tsv is the reader's 1,438-gene input list for a later enrichment run — 1,438 rows, 1,438 unique IDs, all ENSMUSG*, every row verified to satisfy p<0.05 AND |log2FC_shrunken_ash|>1 AND baseMean>10, 850 up / 588 down (sign check: median KL/WL normalised ratio of the up genes = 3.78, consistent with positive log2FC = higher in KD). It carries both shrunken and unshrunken LFC plus padj so any threshold variant can be re-derived. It is ENSMUSG-keyed, so a KEGG_2019_Mouse run still needs the ENSMUSG->symbol map (none obtainable here; 1,438/1,438 unmapped in results/id_mapping_report.json).

FINAL POSITION (submission): DESeq2-equivalent NB2 DE for KL vs WL (hand-rolled engine, ash-style EB LFC shrinkage; permutation-null calibrated at 0-28 false positives vs 1,438 real) yields 1,438 significant DGEs (850 up / 588 down in KD) at p<0.05, |shrunken log2FC|>1, baseMean>10; the gseapy/KEGG_2019_Mouse glutathione-metabolism overlap the question asks for is NOT computable in this capsule (no gseapy in any of 10 interpreters, no KEGG_2019_Mouse copy on any mount, no ENSMUSG->symbol map, lo-only network namespace with no TLS CA bundle and no proxy) and has been left undetermined rather than fabricated. Finish path stays one command: drop KEGG_2019_Mouse.gmt (plus results/libraries/ensg2symbol.tsv if symbol-keyed) and rerun analysis/run_analysis.py, which prints the exact Term string, the set-intersection overlap cross-checked against Overlap x/y, padj under both backgrounds, and the integer.
